SELECT D.degree_summary_name
FROM Students S
JOIN Student_Enrolment C ON S.student_id = C.student_id

JOIN Semesters S2 ON D.semester_id = S2.semester_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses C2 ON C2.student_course_id = C.student_id

ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

JOIN (
  SELECT treatment_type_code, AVG(cost_of_treatment) AS avg_cost
  FROM Treatments
  GROUP BY treatment_type_code
) T2
ON T1.treatment_type_code = T2.treatment_type_code AND T1.cost_of_treatment < T2.avg_cost
SELECT T1.Model FROM car_names AS T1 INNER JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Id WHERE T2.Horsepower = '130' ORDER BY T2.Horsepower LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  O.first_name, 
  O.last_name, 
  S.size_description 
FROM 
  Owners O 
  JOIN Dogs D ON O.owner_id = D.owner_id 
  JOIN Sizes S ON D.size_code = S.size_code

SELECT O.first_name, D.name
FROM Owners O
JOIN Dogs D ON O.owner_id = D.owner_id

SELECT O.first_name, D.name
FROM Owners O
JOIN Dogs D ON O.owner_id = D.dog_id
WHERE O.state = 'Virginia'

SELECT 
  D.date_arrived, 
  D.date_departed 
FROM 
  Dogs D 
  JOIN Treatments T ON D.dog_id = T.dog_id
SELECT last_name FROM Owners WHERE age = ( SELECT MIN(age) FROM Dogs ) ORDER BY age ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT email_address 
FROM Owners 
WHERE state IN ('Hawaii', 'Wisconsin')

SELECT 
  P.role_code, 
  P.street, 
  P.city, 
  P.state
FROM 
  Professionals P
WHERE 
  P.city LIKE '%West%'
SELECT COUNT(owner_id) FROM Owners WHERE owner_id NOT IN (SELECT dog_id FROM Dogs)

SELECT 
  D.name, 
  D.age, 
  D.weight 
FROM 
  Dogs D 
WHERE 
  D.abandoned_yn = '1'

SELECT charge_amount
FROM Charges
WHERE charge_amount = ( SELECT MAX(charge_amount) FROM Charges )

SELECT 
  P.first_name, 
  P.last_name, 
  P.email_address, 
  P.home_phone, 
  P.cell_number
FROM 
  Professionals P
